name: The Fool
upright_meaning: Pure beginning and total faith. Stepping off the precipice into the uncharted void without terror.
reversed_meaning: Recklessness, blind naivety, refusal to heed sensors, or hesitation masking dread.

name: The Magician
upright_meaning: As above, so below. Aligning tool, intent, and element to manifest physical outcome.
reversed_meaning: Illusion, deceptive posturing, misdirected energy, or uncalibrated devices.

name: The High Priestess
upright_meaning: The quiet voice behind the altar. Stillness yields encrypted wisdom.
reversed_meaning: Ignoring instinct, surface superficiality, paranoia, or suppressed knowledge.

name: The Emperor
upright_meaning: The iron throne and lawful order. Stability built through relentless execution and established protocol.
reversed_meaning: Tyrannical control, brittle rigidity, failure of governance, or broken lines of command.

name: The Hierophant
upright_meaning: The codified doctrine and transmission of ancestral rites. Respect for heritage and tested structures.
reversed_meaning: Dogmatic stagnation, oppressive orthodoxy, or hollow rituals devoid of spirit.

name: The Hermit
upright_meaning: Stepping back from the noise of the hive. Truth discovered in silent vigil and individual inquiry.
reversed_meaning: Isolation turning to bitterness, withdrawal from duty, or fear of the world outside.

name: The Wheel of Fortune
upright_meaning: The turning cog of circumstance. Align with momentum rather than resisting the inevitable turn.
reversed_meaning: Resisting the cycle, misfortune born of stagnation, or clinging to the past rim.

name: The Tower
upright_meaning: Lightning shatters the citadel of pride. Sudden disruption exposes brittle dogma, freeing the foundation.
reversed_meaning: Averting necessary collapse, trapped in decay, or fear of dismantling illusions.

name: Knight of Chalices
upright_meaning: The visionary messenger riding under the banner of deep devotion. Romantic, sensitive, and dedicated to the quest.
reversed_meaning: Emotional manipulation, passive escapism, fickle loyalty, or ungrounded daydreaming.

name: Ace of Chalices
upright_meaning: The uncorrupted font of feeling. Grace, new intimacy, and deep spiritual communion.
reversed_meaning: Spilled vessel, emotional depletion, blocked affection, or spiritual fatigue.
